title_en: November 2026 Schedule for Safety and Environment Training for Research Activity Workers (New Training)
summary: The new-employee Safety and Environment Training for research activity workers will be held on 20 November 2026 at the Environmental Safety Institute, Building 98, Room 101. Applications are made by email, and seats may close early if the session is full.
applies_to: Research activity workers who have not completed the new Safety and Environment Training (a requirement for graduate school / thesis qualifying examination eligibility).

dates.what: Safety and Environment Training (new training) session

steps: Apply by sending an email that states your affiliation, name, portal ID and personal contact details. The email address is given in the original notice.
Apply early, as registration may close early if seats run out.
On Friday, 20 November 2026, attend the training from 09:30 to 18:30 at the Environmental Safety Institute, Building 98, Room 101, bringing bottled water and writing materials.
Remain for the entire session; attendance is checked at random times, and leaving without permission will result in the training being recorded as not completed.
translation:
November 2026 Schedule for Safety and Environment Training for Research Activity Workers (New Training)

1. Who must attend
- Research activity workers who have not completed the new Safety and Environment Training (a requirement for graduate school / thesis qualifying examination [논자시] eligibility).

2. Date, time and venue
- Friday, 20 November 2026, 09:30–18:30 (Environmental Safety Institute [환경안전원], Building 98, Room 101)

3. What to bring
- Bottled water (no other beverages are permitted) and writing materials. (Parking discount vouchers and lunch will not be provided.)

4. Application and enquiries
- Send an email stating your affiliation, name, portal ID and personal contact details. The email address is given in the original notice.

5. Other information
- Attendance will be checked at random times. Leaving without permission will result in the training being recorded as not completed.
- Registration will close early if seats run out.
- Additional training sessions are planned for December or January.
